meta.name: accessibility-skill
meta.description: Adds automated accessibility (a11y) testing to test suites on TestMu AI cloud by enabling WCAG scans through driver capabilities. Framework-agnostic, works with Selenium, Playwright, and Cypress. Use when user mentions "accessibility", "a11y", "WCAG", "accessibility scan", "accessibility testing". Triggers on: "accessibility testing", "a11y scan", "WCAG compliance", "accessibility audit LambdaTest", "is my page accessible".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为测试套件添加自动化无障碍扫描
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在测试流程中自动检测页面无障碍问题
copy.tagline_en: Add automated accessibility scanning to your test suites
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automatically detect accessibility issues in your test suites

howto.what: 装上后，Claude能在你提及辅助功能测试时，指导你在TestMu AI云上启用WCAG扫描。它支持设置WCAG版本、最佳实践等，并可选择手动触发或自动扫描。结果在仪表板查看，程序化读取需用MCP服务器。
howto.when: 当你提到“accessibility”、“a11y”等辅助功能关键词，或询问页面是否可访问时触发。

say.text: 帮我在TestMu AI上给Selenium测试添加辅助功能扫描。
say.note: Claude会指导配置capabilities并触发扫描。

say.text: 如何让每次页面导航自动扫描？
say.note: Claude会解释仅Selenium支持自动扫描。

howto.what_en: After installation, when you mention accessibility testing, Claude can guide you to enable WCAG scans on TestMu AI cloud by setting driver capabilities, with options for manual trigger or auto-scan (Selenium only). Results are on the dashboard; for programmatic access, use Accessibility MCP server.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "accessibility", "a11y", "WCAG", or ask if a page is accessible.

say_en.text: Add accessibility scanning to my Selenium tests on TestMu AI.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through capability setup and trigger.

say_en.text: Enable WCAG 2.1 AA checks in Playwright.
How to auto-scan every page navigation?
say_en.note: Claude explains auto-scan is only for Selenium.
